bullets.text: A two-foot-wide sinkhole on Velachery Main Road near Nehru Nagar caused traffic disruption, and the office should monitor repair works.

Spot pelicans resting on high-voltage electricity towers in the Pallikaranai marshland are dying from electrocution, and the office should coordinate preventive measures with utility providers.
The Tamil Nadu Vanigar Sangangalin Peramaippu youth wing organized an anti-drug marathon in Besant Nagar to curb substance abuse among youths.
Students and parents near Tiruttani are worried about a school campus overtaken by bushes and venomous creatures, requiring immediate site clearing by officials.
Thousands of devotees gathered at the Tiruttani Murugan temple and waited three hours for darshan, prompting the office to review crowd management protocols.
L&T's Vyoma AI has broken ground on a 52 MW liquid-cooled data centre near Chennai, signaling major regional tech infrastructure growth.
The Greater Chennai Corporation Commissioner launched a mobile screening and dialysis vehicle funded by Mobis India through CSR.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 is scheduled for November 14 at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway to connect founders and investors.
